# Go by Example

These programs are from [Go by Example](https://gobyexample.com), by Mark
McGranaghan and Eli Bendersky, copied without change from
https://github.com/mmcgrana/gobyexample at commit
0383d41ee84bd75e07cd5603944af1613477f421 (2026-11-21): each
`examples/<name>/<name>.go` is `<name>.go.txt` here. The `.txt` suffix keeps
them out of this repository's Go tooling; they are data that
`gopatina-parity` measures GoPatina against (docs/QUALITY.md). The
testing-and-benchmarking example, a test file rather than a program, is
left out.
